title: The 5 Fastest Animals on Earth, Ranked (the Cheetah Is Only #4)

scenes.text: The five fastest animals on Earth, ranked. The cheetah doesn't even come close to number one.

scenes.label: Pronghorn · 55 mph
scenes.text: Number five: the pronghorn. Fifty-five miles an hour, and it can hold that for miles.

scenes.label: Cheetah · 70 mph
scenes.text: Number four: the cheetah. Seventy miles an hour, but only for about twenty seconds.

scenes.label: Free-tailed bat · 100 mph
scenes.text: Number three: the Mexican free-tailed bat. One hundred miles an hour in level flight, measured by aircraft.

scenes.label: Golden eagle · 200 mph
scenes.text: Number two: the golden eagle. In a hunting dive, close to two hundred miles an hour.

scenes.label: Peregrine falcon · 240 mph
scenes.text: Number one: the peregrine falcon. Two hundred and forty miles an hour in a dive. The fastest animal alive.

description:
The five fastest animals on Earth, ranked by top speed.
The cheetah is only number four. Two birds and a bat beat it, and the winner hits 240 mph in a dive.
Which one surprised you most?
first_comment: Which one would you have put at number one? And which animal should we rank next?
